editorial:
You know that feeling when you just want to kick back with something light and silly? That is exactly what this movie delivers. A documentary filmmaker heads to Jellystone Park to shoot a project and quickly runs into Yogi Bear, his loyal sidekick Boo-Boo, and Ranger Smith. The setup is simple and fun, and the park itself feels like a bright, colorful playground. The humor is mostly aimed at kids, but there are enough goofy moments to keep adults smiling too. The story moves along at a quick pace, so you never feel bored.

The acting is energetic, especially from the ranger and the filmmaker, and the animated bears blend into the live-action world better than you might expect. On the downside, the plot is pretty predictable and some jokes fall flat. Still, if you are looking for an easy family movie night pick, this one works well. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Yogi and Boo-Boo team up with Ranger Smith to stop a greedy mayor from selling Jellystone Park to developers. They use their usual picnic-basket tricks and quick thinking to expose the mayor's plan in front of everyone. The park is saved, Yogi gets to stay, and Ranger Smith finally earns some respect. The movie ends on a happy note with the bears and rangers celebrating together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies and animated adventures.
